# The removed JavaScript IMAP cache path distinguished offline bodies from memory-cache data

In the 1285 JavaScript ImapChannel, the shared cache-stream handler discarded a failed body only if it had an offlineHdr. It did not try to invalidate an arbitrary in-memory cache stream as an offline message. That JS implementation is absent from the fixed accepted revision; native IMAP remains. Treat this as historical source context, not a current API recommendation or evidence that IMAP support was removed. No stream test was executed. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Historical JavaScript IMAP cache recovery.
